gripOrHq.title: Corporate Coup
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

gripOrHq.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Fortress Architects
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Cost to install ice is reduced by [1].

heapOrArchives.title: Red Herrings
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

heapOrArchives.title: Antiquated Interface Routines
heapOrArchives.rulesText: All ice on this fort has +1 strength.

heapOrArchives.title: Investment Firm
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Take [1] from Investment Firm, if it has any bits, at the start of each of your turns. Whenever [1] or more bits are added to your pool, you may put [2] from the bank on Investment Firm for each [1] you choose not to add to your pool. Effects that give you bits at the start of your turn cannot be used this way.

heapOrArchives.title: Braindance Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Braindance Campaign when you rez it. Take [2] from Braindance Campaign at the start of each of your turns. When all the bits have been removed, trash Braindance Campaign.

discardCards.title: Rent-I-Con
discardCards.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

discardCards.title: Schematics Search Engine
discardCards.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, expose all of the Corp's installed cards.

discardCards.title: Panzer Run
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Finders Keepers
discardCards.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

discardCards.title: Networking
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [9]. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.rulesText: Gain [9]. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Finders Keepers
discardCards.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

discardCards.title: Gypsy™ Schedule Analyzer
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, do not access any cards. Instead, reveal cards one at a time from R&D until you reveal an agenda card or there are no cards left in R&D. Store the agenda, if any, in HQ and shuffle the other revealed cards, if any, into R&D.

rig.title: Psychic Friend
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break code gate subroutine. [2]: +1 strength until end of turn

rig.title: Zetatech Portastation
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Zetatech Portastation when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for playing preps. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Elena Laskova
rig.rulesText: Whenever you play a prep, gain an additional [1] the first time you gain bits from its effect. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.
